project.name: Sentinel OS
project.goal: Build a role-based industrial safety platform combining JSA generation, Permit-to-Work, safety checklists, LOTO, approvals, document management, lifecycle tracking, renewal, extension, closure, notifications and reporting.

roles.access_rule: Use strict server-side RBAC. Each role gets a separate workflow and dashboard. Do not expose manager-only approval controls to supervisors or safety-officer-only controls to supervisors.

part_A.name: Basic Information
part_A.purpose: Capture all job, location, personnel, contractor and timing information.

part_B.name: Measures to be Taken by Permit Initiator
common_checklist: Workplace clean and free from unwanted material
part_B.response_logic: Use Yes/No/Not Applicable. If a hazard existed but was eliminated through a verified precaution, the final response may be No.

gas_testing.ongoing_rule: Support configurable repeated gas testing intervals for jobs such as confined-space entry and other risk-based cases.

ppe.rule: Recommend PPE dynamically from work type, hazards, JSA and validated reference data.

hot_work: Adjacent areas checked for fire spread
confined_space: Continuous or periodic gas monitoring as risk requires

part_C.name: Measures to be Taken by Permittee

sequence: Permit becomes active after required approvals

jsa_generation.purpose: AI-assisted Job Safety Analysis generation from job details.
generation_steps: Recommend controls using hierarchy of controls
jsa_generation.preinstalled_examples: Include example JSA templates for common industrial work. Treat them as starting templates, not automatic approval or regulatory truth.

rules: Never invent a clause, section, standard or regulatory requirement.
Every regulatory recommendation should be traceable to a configured source document.
Store source title, clause/section, revision/version, effective date and applicability.
If a requirement is uncertain, mark it for verification instead of guessing.
Company SOPs must be configurable and can override generic templates only through authorized governance.

loto.grouping: Allow multiple isolation points and tags to be linked to one equipment/job identifier.

ppe_chemical_matrix.rule: Never infer chemical compatibility without validated manufacturer, SDS or authoritative reference data.

excel_sync.architecture_rule: Use the application database as the source of truth. Excel is an integration/export/reporting layer, not the primary database.

visibility.safety_officer: Safety verification and relevant lifecycle visibility

principles: Clear separation between Supervisor, Safety Officer and Manager workflows

requirements: Server-side RBAC
Authenticated critical actions
Immutable audit trail for critical changes
User and timestamp recorded on approvals and safety verification
API keys stored server-side only
Secure document access
Uploaded-file validation
AI generation audit logging
Source-reference logging

hard_rules: AI output is advisory until reviewed by authorized personnel.
AI must not silently overwrite user-entered safety information.
Store AI input, model/version, output, review status and references.
Never expose AI/API secrets to client-side code.

principles: JSA templates and reference documents are versioned.

must_verify: Supervisor cannot access Safety Officer verification
Safety Officer cannot perform manager approval unless explicitly configured
LOTO records link to correct equipment/job

implementation_sequence: 2. Database schema and permit state machine

developer_instruction.build_target: Production-oriented industrial safety platform, not a static mockup.
developer_instruction.database_rule: Persist every permit, JSA, checklist response, gas test, LOTO record, approval, document, extension and closure.
developer_instruction.configuration_rule: Permit categories, checklist questions, PPE recommendations, gas-test intervals, approval routing and document requirements must be configurable.
developer_instruction.safety_rule: When a regulatory requirement cannot be verified, flag it instead of inventing it.
developer_instruction.completion_rule: Do not declare the platform complete until the full permit lifecycle has been tested from initiation through approval, active work, revalidation, extension and closure.

document.name: SentinelOS_PTW_Reference_Specification
document.rule: The uploaded form is the minimum PTW safety baseline. Never remove a source safety step; additional controls may be added. Every field, check, response, signature, renewal and closure must be digitally stored and auditable.

source_pages.2: Standby Person duties, PPE matrix, Job Handover
source_pages.4: Excavation renewal, closure and work instructions

common_header: Job To Be Carried Out By

part_1_checks: Equipment/confined space cleaned with water/steam and sufficiently cooled
Complete isolation by blinding or pipeline disconnection
Repeat gas test at configured interval
Fresh air supplied where required; no instrument air

gas_test.rule: Intervals must be configurable and risk-based.

standby_person_duties: Ensure workers are trained and aware
Ensure gas testing at required intervals
Do not exceed permitted occupied-space duration
Do not enter the confined space
Remain outside unless relieved by authorized attendant
Know hazardous conditions and exposure symptoms
Ensure emergency duties can be performed safely
Do not permit unauthorized night/out-of-condition work
Ensure continuous air supply where required

electrical_group: Cable de-energized and checked by authorized cable tracer
operation_issuer_group: JSA with diagram, shoring/sloping and escape ladder
work_instructions: If excavation depth exceeds 1.5 m, take confined-space permit along with excavation permit.
Do not start excavation without clearance from all relevant agencies.
Separate work permit for different agencies/locations.
Attach schematic drawing when excavation may extend to more than one plant; issue separate permits as applicable.
Trenches/foundations shall be excavated uniformly so loose earth does not slide/fall on workers.
Keep loose material at least 1 m away from excavation edge and remove early.
Cut trenches from top to bottom with adequate slope.
Secure sides properly to prevent collapse.
Where underground cables pass, remove appropriate soil layers and do not damage cables.
Excavation shall be under responsible-person supervision.
Ensure proper approach to digging area throughout the job.
Secure excavated area with hard barricading and mark to prevent fall/trip.

part_1_checks: Equipment completely isolated from live source
Equipment removed from vicinity where required
DO NOT START SUPPLY / WORK IN PROGRESS sign
Shock-proof rubber gloves and expiry checked
Live electrical line over roof de-energized
Full-body harness with double cross rope

job_rows: PNCB/MNCB/ONCB/PCDB/DCB/TCB/Tetra Chloro Benzene and listed chlorinated chemicals
ppe_matrix.rule: Preserve every matrix row and column as a versioned baseline.

checks: Line fitted and flange nuts/bolts tightened

rules: AI is advisory until human safety review.

critical_rules: Every source checklist item must be a real stored field.
Signatures must store identity and timestamp.
Renewals must create history, never overwrite.
NA must be recorded, not used to delete a checklist item.
Unauthorized roles cannot approve or verify.
Additional controls may be added but source safety controls may not be reduced.
final_instruction: Before coding, compare this specification against the uploaded PDF page-by-page. Mark any unreadable/ambiguous scan content as REQUIRES_VERIFICATION rather than guessing. Then implement the digital PTW. The reference form is the minimum baseline; the system may only add safety controls, never reduce them.

purpose: Provide Antigravity with high-level visual and UX direction inspired by a security/monitoring interface, while explicitly requiring an original design. Do not reproduce the reference website.

variation_required: Choose an original composition and spacing system.
Use a distinct visual identity while retaining a dark security/technology mood.
Adapt components to the new product's actual information architecture.
Invent new labels, icons, illustrations, and sample data.
Avoid making the result visually interchangeable with the reference.

visual_direction.density: medium information density with clear breathing room
visual_direction.surfaces: layered dark panels with restrained borders and depth
visual_direction.accent_strategy: one primary technology accent plus semantic success/warning/error states
visual_direction.effects: subtle glow or atmospheric effects only where useful; avoid excessive neon
visual_direction.typography: modern sans-serif with strong numeric readability
visual_direction.contrast: high contrast for primary information and accessible secondary text

design_tokens.primary_accent: cyan/blue family, but allow Antigravity to choose an original shade

app_structure.navigation: sidebar or alternative navigation pattern; do not force the reference layout
app_structure.header: context-aware top area for title, status, actions, or search
app_structure.secondary_content: drawer, panel, or secondary column when useful

login_experience.goal: Secure, polished entry point that establishes the product identity.
login_experience.design_note: Create a new login composition rather than reproducing the reference login screen.

post_login_experience.goal: Give users an at-a-glance operational overview and easy access to deeper information.
post_login_experience.composition_note: Antigravity should choose an original arrangement based on the target website.

component_guidance.cards: Use cards selectively to group related information.
component_guidance.tables: Use when dense records need scanning; keep rows readable.
component_guidance.badges: Use semantic status labels with restrained colors.
component_guidance.buttons: Clear primary/secondary hierarchy with hover, focus, disabled and loading states.
component_guidance.charts: Minimal, legible, dashboard-native; avoid decorative charts.
component_guidance.alerts: Prioritize severity, source, time and action.
component_guidance.monitoring: May represent camera feeds, images, maps, sensor data or another domain-specific visualization.

responsive.tablet: reflow panels and reduce navigation footprint
responsive.mobile: collapse navigation, stack content, preserve important actions, allow horizontal scrolling only for genuinely dense data

requirements: keyboard navigable
visible focus states
sufficient contrast
semantic controls
labels for inputs
do not rely on color alone for status

implementation_instruction: Use this JSON as design direction, not a pixel-perfect specification. Build an original, reusable, responsive UI for the new website. The reference should influence mood, hierarchy and interaction patterns only.

document.title: Industrial Permit to Work (PTW) System - Phase 2 Extraction

permit_fields.description: Pre-printed unique numbering block for tracking and audits.
From time/date and To time/date.
Department, Section, or Contractor Name.
Area / Unit / Equipment number or exact physical plant location.
Nearest fire alarm point for emergency reporting.
Exact maintenance/repair job; minimum two lines.
permit_fields.source: IS Annex A; OISD Annexure-I; OISD Cl. 5.0-d

permit_fields.description: Executing company supervisor accepting the permit.
Checklist with Sr. No., Item, Done and Not Required columns.
Expected residual hazard checkboxes.
Additional PPE checklist based on hazards.
Name, designation, signature, date and telephone number.
Receiver certifies completion/stoppage and issuer verifies area safety.
Date, shift From/To, additional precautions and issuer/receiver signatures.

checklist_items.item: Surrounding area checked, cleaned and covered
Area cordoned off and caution boards/tags provided

isolation_preparation.description: Completely isolate equipment from mechanical, thermal, hydraulic and electrical energy sources.
Flanges must first be wedged open before line breaking.
Oil/hydrocarbon draining must go into a closed system; floor draining is prohibited.
Slip blinding or physical line disconnection with end-blinding of live ends is required when work resumes after a break or is planned for longer than one day.

area_equipment_conditions.description: Walkways, platforms and passages must be free of slip, trip and fall hazards.
Scaffolding, ladders, cranes, chain pulley blocks and lifting tackles must be tested/certified, with SWL and test date displayed.
Rotating parts must be stopped and mechanically blocked against inadvertent rotation.
Portable/mobile electrical tools require joint-free sound-insulated cables and ELCB connection; normally restricted to non-hazardous operating areas unless additional precautions apply.

ppe.source: IS Cl. 5.0; IS Table 3; OISD Annexure-I

associated_permits_approvals.requirement: Separate permit at or above 1.8 m where permanent platform and guardrails are unavailable.
associated_permits_approvals.source: IS Cl. 3.6; IS A-6.12; OISD Cl. 5.0-e

associated_permits_approvals.requirement: Cross-reference electrical permit number/date where applicable.
Issuer/Shift In-charge and Receiver/Company Supervisor or Engineer sign the permit.

validity_closure.closure_rule: Permit is closed only after receiver certifies completion/stoppage and issuer verifies area cleanliness and safety.
validity_closure.source: IS Cl. 9.1; IS Cl. 9.2.6; IS Cl. 7.5.2; OISD Cl. 5.0-k; OISD Cl. 5.0-v

process_isolation.description: Slip blinding or physical disconnection plus blinding of live ends is mandatory. Valve isolation alone is not acceptable as standalone hot-work isolation.
Depressurize, drain, steam, purge and flush equipment to eliminate trapped hydrocarbons.
Check for oil/gas trapped behind internal equipment linings.
process_isolation.source: IS Table 4 Sl. iv; OISD Cl. 6.0-x

process_isolation.description: Remove pyrophoric scale or keep it continuously wet with water during the job.
process_isolation.source: IS Table 4 Sl. x; OISD Cl. 6.0-u

area_environment.description: Remove flammables/combustibles such as oil, grease, rags and grass.
Cover/seal drains, sewers, CBD channels, manholes and pits with wet fire-resistant blankets.
area_environment.source: IS Cl. 4.1.12; IS Table 4 Sl. iii; OISD Cl. 6.0-e

area_environment.description: Evaluate hazards from nearby routine/non-routine operations and alert affected personnel.
area_environment.source: IS Table 4 Sl. iv; OISD Cl. 6.0-f

area_environment.description: Maintain free access for fire tender approach.

gas_testing.source: IS Cl. 6.1; IS Cl. 6.2; IS Cl. 6.3.1; IS B-6.6; IS B-6.7; OISD Cl. 4.3; OISD Cl. 5.0-n

fire_protection.description: Running fire-water hose connected to a pressurized hydrant and portable fire extinguishers must be available and operational.
fire_protection.source: IS Table 4 Sl. xiii; OISD Cl. 6.0-h

fire_protection.description: Dedicated standby personnel from Process, Maintenance, Contractor, Fire or Safety as determined by issuer.
fire_protection.source: IS Table 4 Sl. iii; OISD Cl. 6.0-t

fire_protection.description: Use non-flammable spark shields/fire-resistant wet blanket cages or booths to contain sparks and slag.
fire_protection.source: IS Cl. 4.1.11; IS Table 4 Sl. v; OISD Cl. 6.0-n

welding_electrical.description: Welding machine in non-hazardous, ventilated area; properly grounded with dedicated insulated return cable.
welding_electrical.source: IS Cl. 4.1.15.1; IS B-6.5; OISD Cl. 5.0-s

welding_electrical.description: Electrical engineer/technician certifies grounding and ELCB connection.
Cables must be joint-free with sound insulation; electrode holders cannot be used as cable connectors for extensions.

gas_cylinders.identification: Color-identifiable; valve caps secured during storage/transport.

vehicle_mobile_equipment.spark_arrestor: PESO-approved spark arrestor required on exhaust of vehicles/internal combustion engines/mobile equipment entering battery operating areas.
vehicle_mobile_equipment.source: IS B-7.1.15; IS Table 4 Sl. i(C); OISD Cl. 6.0-w

validity_closure.source: IS Cl. 9.1; IS Cl. 9.2.6; OISD Cl. 5.0-k

dos: Ensure a valid work permit before starting.
Comply fully with permit conditions.
Isolate equipment from all energy sources.
Keep walkways and passages free of slip, trip and fall hazards.
Drain oil only into a closed system.
Provide proper illumination when working in darkness.
Use non-sparking tools in flammable areas.
Ensure hand tools are in good condition.
Wedge open flanges first.
Use required PPE; helmet and safety shoes are mandatory inside the plant.
Provide ventilation and illumination for confined-space cold work.
Use joint-free, sound-insulated electrical cables.
Connect portable/mobile electrical equipment to ELCB.
Ensure lifting equipment/tools/tackles are tested and display SWL and test date.
Barricade areas below lifting machines, cranes or chain pulley blocks.
Conduct gas tests before issuing a permit wherever required.
Remove scrap and unused material after completion.
Know emergency facilities, escape routes, assembly points and siren codes.
donts: Never stand or work under suspended loads.
Never enter without safety helmet and shoes.
Do not wear loose or synthetic clothes while working.
Do not use shortcuts.
Do not use lamps above 24 V in confined spaces.
Do not operate machinery without replacing guards on exposed moving parts.

dos: Ensure a valid work permit and clearance before starting.
Comply fully with permit conditions.
Remove flammables/combustibles and cover/seal drains and sewers where hydrocarbons may be present.
Keep gas cylinders upright and identifiable by color.
Check cylinder hoses for cuts and kinks; use specified hose colors.
Use appropriate PPE.
Arrest sparks, especially during hot work at height.
Use flashback arrestors and welding lighters for oxy-acetylene work.
Provide ventilation and illumination for confined-space hot work.
Use joint-free, sound-insulated electrical cables.
Connect portable/mobile electrical equipment to ELCB.
Ensure lifting equipment/tools/tackles are tested and display SWL/test date.
Barricade areas below cranes/lifting machines.
Conduct gas tests and ensure the area is free of hydrocarbons.
Ensure battery-area vehicles have approved spark arrestors and use designated routes.
Know emergency facilities, escape routes, assembly points and siren codes.
Ensure hand tools are in good condition.
Keep valve caps on cylinders during storage/transport when shrouds are not provided.
donts: Never stand or work under suspended loads.
Never enter without safety helmet and safety shoes.
Do not wear loose or synthetic clothes while working.
Do not use shortcuts.
Do not use lamps above 24 V in confined spaces.
Do not use electrode holders as cable connectors for cable extension.
Never keep acetylene cylinders horizontally, even when empty.
Never use a grinder without a wheel guard.

numerical_requirements.rule: Maximum manual/mechanical soil digging or chipping under Cold Work Permit; deeper excavation requires Excavation Permit.
numerical_requirements.source: IS 17893 Cl. 3.1.2-j; IS Cl. 3.4; OISD-STD-105 Cl. 4.2

numerical_requirements.rule: Maximum surface temperature for painting under Cold Work Permit.
Separate Work at Height Permit required when permanent platform/guardrails are unavailable.
numerical_requirements.source: IS 17893 Cl. 3.1.2-k; Cl. 3.6; Cl. 125; Annex F; OISD Cl. 5.0-e

numerical_requirements.rule: Approved full-body harness with lifeline required above this height.
numerical_requirements.source: IS 17893 Cl. F-12.10; Cl. F-19 Notes

numerical_requirements.rule: Work within this radial distance of uninsulated LT/HT power cables requires Hot Work Permit.
Maximum temporary portable lighting voltage; lamp must be approved FLP type.
Minimum oxygen concentration for safe confined-space work without fresh-air mask.
Above this concentration atmosphere is oxygen-enriched and extremely hazardous.
Maximum combustible gas concentration for vessel entry only when no hot work is performed.
Entry permitted only with approved air-supplied breathing apparatus below this limit.
Absolute maximum hydrocarbon/explosive-meter reading for hot work.
Gas-test radius around hot work including nearby flange joints, valve glands and drain channels.
Maximum validity for Cold Work, Hot Work, Vessel Entry and Excavation permits.
Standard single-shift permit validity; continuation requires revalidation.
Work suspension beyond one calendar day invalidates the permit.
Minimum retention period for closed original acceptor/executor permits.
Minimum retention for completed/used permits from completion or commissioning, whichever is later.
Minimum formal training duration for authorized permit issuers/receivers.
Maximum interval for refresher training; refresher duration is minimum one day.
Maximum excavation permit validity for shutdown units/facilities.
Maximum excavation permit validity for major construction projects.
Excavation at or below this depth is treated as a confined space requiring separate entry permit.
numerical_requirements.source: IS 17893 Cl. 115; Annex D Note 4; Cl. D-26.1.5

numerical_requirements.rule: Minimum distance from excavation edge for soil/material placement, or trench depth, whichever is greater.
Minimum standby attendants at manhole for confined-space entry.
numerical_requirements.source: IS 17893 Cl. B-6.8; Table 4 Sl. vii; OISD Cl. 4.2

numerical_requirements.rule: Minimum scaffold platform plank/surface gap classified as a TRAP hazard.
Minimum wait after stopping mechanical forced ventilation before confined-space gas safety test.

title: Industrial Permit to Work (PTW) System - Phase 5 Excavation Extraction
description: Exhaustive extraction of excavation, digging, and floor-breaking requirements from IS 17893:2023 (Annex D), OISD-STD-105, and Aarti Industries Format No. AIL/SFT/F/32 Rev 02.

IS_17893_2023_Annex_D_Header_Fields.label: ii) Work Clearance From : __________ h of date_________ To ________ h of Date_______________
iv) Exact Location of Work (Area/Unit/Equipment No. etc.) : _________________________________

Aarti_Industries_Header_Fields: Type of the Job: MOC / GPC / BD / PM / USC / Project
Tracking Serial Number: Sr. No G
Time and Date Bounds: From / To with Date and Time
Functional Departments: Dept. / Section
Local Unit and Plant Context: Plant
Equipment Identification: Equipment
Cross-Reference Permits: Other Permit No.
SAP Maintenance Tracking: Notification No.
Description of the job to be carried out
Job Location
Contractor Deployment: Job to be carried out by / Dept / Contractor
Manpower Count: No. of persons working
Executing Supervisor: Name of company Supervisor

IS_17893_2023_Annex_D.warning: THIS IS NOT AN EXCAVATION PERMIT
IS_17893_2023_Annex_D.registration_flow: Clearance is initiated by Executor. GSI/Area In-charge signs before shift FSO. FSO verifies departmental clearances, registers the document, and retains duplicate. Clearance is officially issued only after Fire Station registration.

OISD_STD_105: Mandatory permission from all concerned sections for excavation regardless of depth.
Physical markers must be placed around proposed excavation boundaries.
Maximum excavation depth must be written on the permit.
Feedback communication system must notify affected departments/sections after excavation completion.

Aarti_Industries: Excavation area free from underground electrical cables: Yes / No / NA
If No: Area marking done on field and layout attached with marking
If No: Cable de-energised and checked by underground cable tracer
If No: Other precautions, e.g. manual excavation
Electrical declaration: excavation area safe; if underground cable is present, respective electrical manager gives area clearance
Approval: Name of Electrical Incharge / Manager, Signature, Date, Time
IS_17893_D17: UNDERGROUND POWER CABLE: Existing / Not existing

Aarti_Industries: Excavation area free from underground Instrument, IT cables: Yes / No / NA
If No: Area marking done on field and layout attached with marking
If No: Cable de-energised
If No: Other precautions, e.g. manual excavation
Instrumentation declaration: excavation area safe; if underground cable is present, respective instrument manager gives area clearance
Approval: Name of Instrument Incharge / Manager, Signature, Date, Time
IS_17893_D23: UNDERGROUND INSTRUMENT CABLE: Existing / Not existing

Aarti_Industries: Excavation area free from Fire Water pipeline: Yes / No / NA
If No: Area marking done on field and layout attached with marking
If No: Other precautions
Fire/Safety declaration: excavation area safe for excavation
Approval: Name of Fire Executive, Signature, Date, Time
IS_17893_D19: UNDERGROUND FIREWATER LINE: Existing / Not existing

Aarti_Industries: Excavation area free from underground process pipelines and other pipelines, toxic chemicals/leakages/seepage/sewage water and utility pipelines: Yes / No / NA
Excavation permitted: Manual / Mechanical (e.g. JCB, floor breaker)
JSA attached with sketch diagram including shoring, sloping and escape ladder arrangements: Yes / No / NA
If No: Area marking done on field and layout attached
If No: Other precautions, e.g. manual excavation
Operations declaration covering work-area preparation, work description, preparations, precautions, JSA and changed conditions
Approval: Name of Area Incharge/Permit Issuer, Signature, Date, Time
IS_17893: Asset Custodian Department representative signs under D-1.1 with Name, Signature and Date.
Permit Issuer/Shift In-Charge grants final permission under D-7 after verifying excavation clearance is obtained and attached under D-8.

inspection_check_grid: LOTO: job/unit electrically isolated; Tag No., electrician name and signature
Shoring provided if depth exceeds 5 ft
Gas test if depth is greater than 1.5 m; H2S, O2, CO, LEL% at 0 Hrs, 4 Hrs, 6 Hrs
Area cordoned and caution boards provided
7_permittee_executor.declaration: I certify that all necessary precautions are taken to carry out work in safe manner. I understand the work site has been prepared for safe work, I understand the precautions and shall ensure the same are followed by the working crew. If change in conditions are observed or instructed, the work shall be stopped and issuer notified.

8_underground_services_general_protectio: Permission and underground clearance must be obtained for excavation regardless of depth under OISD, and below 30 cm under IS.
Only manual excavation using hand tools is permitted directly adjacent to identified underground active lines; under-digging/mechanical excavation is prohibited around active lines.
Attach site-specific marked-up schematic drawing and site layout showing buried lines.
9_burial_detail_cables: IS 17893 D-17: identify underground power cable as existing/not existing and apply isolation, LOTO and site marking precautions.
Aarti Part-I Section A.2: underground cables must be de-energised and checked by underground cable tracer before floor-breaking.
Aarti Work Instruction 10: remove only earth layers where underground cables pass and ensure cables are not damaged.
10_burial_detail_pipelines: IS 17893 D-22: underground product line and utility line checklist signed by Operations.
OISD-STD-105 Cl. 5.0(v): clearance protects sewers, storm drains and CBD channels; dyke cutting is extremely critical due to potential hydrocarbon spills.
Aarti Part-I Section D.1: Operations verifies area is free from process lines, steam/utility pipes, toxic chemical seepage and sewage lines.
11_burial_detail_firewater_lines: IS 17893 D-19: underground firewater line clearance; maintain safe distance and identify pipe depth.
Aarti Part-I Section C: Fire/Safety declares area safe; firewater mains must not be disturbed and access to nearby hydrants must remain unhindered.
12_burial_detail_communication_cables: IS 17893 D-18: underground telecommunication cable clearance signed by Telecom/IT.
OISD-STD-105 Cl. 4.2: telephone line preservation during excavation.
13_burial_detail_instrument_cables: IS 17893 D-23: underground instrument cable checked and cleared by Instrumentation.
Aarti Part-I Section B: Instrumentation checks IT and signal cable status; de-energisation mandatory if cables lie directly within excavation zone.
14_burial_detail_cathodic_protection_cab: IS 17893 D-24: underground cathodic protection cable existence must be checked and precautions listed to prevent severing anodes or wiring.
15_manual_excavation: IS 17893 Table 14 Sl. iv: Hand excavation only can be checked as a binding requirement.
IS 17893 D-26.2.5: manual excavation compulsory up to 1.5 m from ground level in operating plant areas.
Aarti Part-I Section D.2: Manual toggle restricts excavation to hand tools.
16_mechanical_excavation: IS 17893 D-26.1.10: special precautions required for mechanical excavators inside refinery; Hot Work Permit required in operating areas except roads.
IS 17893 D-26.2.5: no mechanical excavation up to 1.5 m in operating plant areas.
Aarti Work Instruction 11: excavation under Responsible Person supervision.
Aarti Part-I Section D.2: Mechanical toggle includes JCB/floor breaker and requires Hot Work Permit and JSA due to spark hazards.
17_shoring: IS 17893 Table 14 Sl. viii: Provide shoring checkbox.
IS 17893 D-26.1.6: excavations 1 m or more must be securely held by bracing/shoring.
Aarti Part-II E.7: shoring provided if depth exceeds 5 ft.
Aarti Work Instruction 9: sides secured properly to avoid collapse.
18_sloping: IS 17893 Table 14 Sl. ix: batter sides to 45 degrees or less.
IS 17893 D-26.1.6: excavations 1 m or more must be stepped back or sloped.

Attach site-specific marked-up schematic drawing and layout showing buried lines.

sections.title: BURIAL DETAIL: CABLES
requirements: IS 17893 D-17: Underground power cable must be identified as existing/not existing.
Precautions include isolation, LOTO, and physical site marking.
Aarti Section A.2: Underground cables must be de-energised and checked by underground cable tracer before floor-breaking.
Aarti Instruction 10: Remove only layers of earth where cables pass and ensure cables are not damaged.

sections.title: BURIAL DETAIL: PIPELINES
requirements: IS 17893 D-22: Underground product line and utility line checklist signed by Operations.
OISD 5.0(v): Clearance protects sewers, storm drains, and CBD channels.
Dyke cutting is extremely critical due to risk of major hydrocarbon spill.
Aarti Section D.1: Operations verifies process lines, steam/utility pipes, toxic chemical seepage, sewage lines and related hazards.

sections.title: BURIAL DETAIL: FIREWATER LINES
requirements: IS 17893 D-19: Underground firewater line clearance.
Maintain minimum safe distance and identify pipe depth.
Aarti Section C: Fire/Safety Group declares area safe.
Firewater mains must not be disturbed and nearby fire hydrant access must remain unhindered.

sections.title: BURIAL DETAIL: COMMUNICATION CABLES
requirements: IS 17893 D-18: Underground telecommunication cable clearance by Telecom/IT.
OISD 4.2: Telephone line preservation during excavation.

sections.title: BURIAL DETAIL: INSTRUMENT CABLES
requirements: IS 17893 D-23: Underground instrument cable checked and cleared by Instrumentation.
Aarti Section B: Instrumentation checks IT and signal cable status.
Cable de-energisation required if directly within excavation zone.

sections.title: BURIAL DETAIL: CATHODIC PROTECTION (CP) CABLES
requirements: IS 17893 D-24: Underground cathodic protection cable existence must be verified.
Dedicated precautions must prevent severing anodes or CP wiring.

sections.title: MANUAL EXCAVATION
requirements: IS 17893 Table 14 Sl iv: Hand excavation only can be selected as binding requirement.
IS 17893 D-26.2.5: Manual excavation compulsory up to 1.5 m from ground level in operating plant areas.
Aarti Section D.2: Manual option restricts excavation to hand shovels and pickaxes.

sections.title: MECHANICAL EXCAVATION
requirements: IS 17893 D-26.1.10: Mechanical excavators inside refinery operating areas require special precautions and Hot Work Permit, except roads.
IS 17893 D-26.2.5: Mechanical excavation prohibited up to 1.5 m depth in operating plant areas.
Aarti Instruction 11: Excavation under Responsible Person supervision.
Aarti Section D.2: Mechanical option includes JCB/floor breaker and requires Hot Work Permit and JSA due to internal-combustion spark hazards.

sections.title: SHORING
requirements: IS 17893 Table 14 Sl viii: Provide shoring checkbox.
IS 17893 D-26.1.6: Excavations of 1 m or more require secure bracing/shoring.
Aarti E.7: Shoring provided if depth exceeds 5 ft.
Aarti Instruction 9: Sides secured properly against collapse.

sections.title: SLOPING
requirements: IS 17893 Table 14 Sl ix: Batter sides to 45 degrees or less.
IS 17893 D-26.1.6: Excavations of 1 m or more must be stepped back to a suitable safe slope.
Aarti Instruction 8: Trenches cut top to bottom with adequate slope.

sections.title: BENCHING
requirements: IS 17893 D-26.1.6: Trenches 1 m or more deep must be stepped back/benched or sloped.
Aarti Instruction 5: Trenches/foundations excavated uniformly to prevent loose earth/material sliding or falling onto workers.

sections.title: ACCESS / ESCAPE
requirements: IS 17893 Table 14 Sl xi: Provide means of access.
IS 17893 D-26.1.4: Sufficient and safe means of access and escape.
Aarti Instruction 12: Proper approach to digging area maintained throughout job.

sections.title: LADDER
requirements: IS 17893 D-26.1.7: Trenches 1.2 m or more deep require at least one ladder per 30.48 m length or fraction.
Ladders extend from trench bottom to at least 1 m above ground.
Aarti E.1: Layout includes escape ladder arrangements.

sections.title: BARRICADING
requirements: IS 17893 Table 14 Sl vii: Barricade checkbox.
IS 17893 D-26.1.8: Hard barricade 1 m high with red/white band or self-glowing caution boards for excavations beyond 1.5 m.
Aarti E.12: Area cordoned and caution boards provided.
Aarti Instruction 14: Excavated area hard barricaded and marked to prevent fall/trip.

sections.title: WARNING LIGHTS
requirements: IS 17893 Table 14 Sl vi: Flashing light; FLP type in hazardous areas.
IS 17893 D-26.1.3: Warning lamps for operating areas/roads during darkness; FLP fixture in hazardous area.

sections.title: SPOIL PILE (EXCAVATED EARTH)
requirements: IS 17893 Table 14 Sl xii: Excavated soil minimum 1 m from edge.
IS 17893 D-26.2.2: Do not dump earth within 1 m of edge or trench depth, whichever is more.
IS 17893 D-26.2.3: Never dump on pathways/approaches, product/steam lines, or emergency facilities including fire hydrants/monitors, fire alarm points, foam pourer inlets, and OWS manhole covers.
Aarti Instruction 6: Loose material at least 1 m away and removed at earliest.

sections.title: VEHICLE MOVEMENT
requirements: IS 17893 D-26.2.4: Vehicles maintain at least 2 m from excavation edge.
Adequate, well-anchored stop blocks prevent vehicles from being driven/reversed into excavation.
Aarti Instruction 7: Vehicle movement near excavated area restricted.

sections.title: ROAD / DYKE CUTTING
requirements: IS 17893 D-25.9/D-25.10: Excavation Clearance plus dedicated Road Closure Format.

Road cuttings properly barricaded with precaution signs and alternate routes displayed.
OISD 5.0(v): Dyke cutting requires elevated authorization due to potential major hydrocarbon spill.
Dyke reconstructed in shortest possible time.

sections.title: GAS TESTING
requirements: IS 17893 D-26.1.5: Excavation checked for fumes/gases heavier than air.

Record at 0 Hrs, 4 Hrs, and 6 Hrs.

sections.title: CONFINED-SPACE ESCALATION
requirements: OISD 4.3: Excavation depth more than 1.2 m treated as confined space.

sections.title: PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT (PPE)
requirements: IS 17893 Table 14 Sl xiv/xv: Body harness/lifeline and gumboot/safety suit toggles.

Aarti E.11: PPE provided and use ensured.

sections.title: JOB SAFETY ANALYSIS (JSA)
requirements: IS 17893 Annex D Note 6: Daily Safety Toolbox Talks based on JSA before contractor work; records maintained.

sections.title: DRAWING / LAYOUT
requirements: IS 17893 D-1.2: Marked-up schematic drawing showing exact cutting bounds attached.
IS 17893 D-14: Sketch of area of excavation enclosed checkbox.
Aarti D.1: Layout attached with permit and marking.

sections.title: WORK INSTRUCTIONS
instructions: If excavation depth is more than 1.5 m, take confined space permit along with excavation permit.
Do not start excavation until clearance from all agencies is obtained.
Separate work permit for different agencies and locations.
Attach schematic drawing if excavation may extend across more than one plant; issue separate permits as applicable.
Excavate trenches/foundations uniformly to prevent loose earth/material from sliding/falling onto workers.
Keep loose material at least 1 m away and remove at earliest.
Restrict vehicle movement near excavated area.
Cut trenches only from top to bottom with adequate slope.
Secure sides properly to prevent collapse.
Where underground cables pass, remove only earth layers necessary and prevent cable damage.
Excavation under Responsible Person supervision.
Maintain proper approach to digging area at all times.
Take extra precautions as necessary.
Secure excavated area with hard barricading and markings to prevent falls/trips.

sections.title: RENEWAL
requirements: IS 17893 Annex D Note 4: Permits maximum 7 days but renewed each shift.
Aarti renewal block: All precautionary measures reviewed and found OK, Date, Time From/To, Permittee signature, Issuer signature, Plant Manager signature.

sections.title: CLOSURE
requirements: IS 17893 D-25.8: Receiver collects all clearance copies and encloses them with closed permit; Issuer closes permit and returns it to Fire Station.
Aarti closure block: Date/Time, Production Dept signature, Mech/Elect/Civil/Inst Dept signature.
Closure confirms safety devices replaced and area cleaned.

sections.title: DO'S AND DON'TS DURING EXCAVATION WORK (ANNEX D-26)
dos: Ensure departmental clearance for all excavation works.
Ensure excavation permit and clearance are obtained and valid.
Barricade all excavations/open trenches; use warning lamps during darkness and FLP fixtures in hazardous areas.
Provide sufficient and safe access and escape.
Keep excavation free from heavier-than-air fumes/gases; treat excavation more than 1.2 m as confined space and obtain entry permit.
For excavation 1 m or more, slope/step back or securely brace sides.
For trenches 1.2 m or more, provide at least one ladder per 30.48 m or fraction; extend ladder 1 m above ground.
For excavation beyond 1.5 m, use 1 m high barricading with red/white bands or self-glowing caution boards.
Carry out cutting from top to bottom.
Use special precautions for mechanical excavators in refinery operating areas; Hot Work Permit required except roads.
Avoid half-road cutting unless specified conditions are complied with.
Use suitable PPE as required by permit.
Report incidents immediately to supervisor and Fire Station.
donts: No undercutting under any circumstances.
Do not dump excavated earth within 1 m of edge or trench depth, whichever is more.
Do not dump earth on pathways, product/steam lines, emergency facilities, or OWS manhole covers.
Do not allow vehicles too close to edge; maintain at least 2 m and provide anchored stop blocks.
No mechanical excavation up to 1.5 m in operating areas; manual excavation required up to that depth.
Do not allow anyone to move on the edge of excavation.

A_permit_types.special_conditions_safety_criteria: All work stopped immediately in case of fire alarm/siren [96, 291, 368, 445]. Hand tools, cranes, lifting tackles must be certified/tested [101, 371]. Walkways free of slip/trip hazards [99, 370].
A_permit_types.approval_requirements: Signed by Issuer (Shift In-Charge) and Receiver/Permittee (Executor/Supervisor) [94, 288, 366, 443].
A_permit_types.renewal_revalidation: Validity: single shift (OISD) or 8 hours (IS) [76, 284, 355, 442]. Can be renewed/extended shift-wise up to maximum 7 calendar days [79, 260, 292, 358, 435, 446]. joint site inspection before renewal [78, 357].
A_permit_types.closure_requirements: Signed by Receiver/Permittee (certifying completion/stoppage, area cleared) and Issuer (verifying area cleared and safe) [94, 289, 366, 444].

A_permit_types.purpose_and_criteria: To authorize any work which produces heat, spark, or flame with sufficient energy to cause ignition of flammable/combustible material or dust [15, 243, 328, 422].
A_permit_types.type_of_work_examples: Welding, grinding, gas cutting, burning, soldering, brazing, open flame, tar melting, electric arc, hot plates, hacksaw cutting on hydrocarbon service lines, online leak sealing with drilling, hot tapping, use of non-FLP equipment (cameras, mobile phones) inside hazardous areas, vehicle entry in hazardous areas [16, 17, 18, 116, 249, 329, 330, 377, 425].
A_permit_types.associated_supporting_permits: Confined space/vessel entry, Working at height, Electrical isolation, Excavation, Radiation/Radiography [107, 125, 374, 379]
A_permit_types.special_conditions_safety_criteria: Gas test is mandatory (hydrocarbon LEL must be zero) [57, 113, 263, 342, 375, 434]. Wet blankets/shields wet with water must contain sparks [37, 277]. Fire extinguisher & running water hose (hydrant) kept ready [39, 272].
A_permit_types.approval_requirements: Shift In-Charge/Issuer, Executor/Receiver, and authorized Plant/Area In-Charge or HOD [58, 62, 69, 343, 346, 351].
A_permit_types.renewal_revalidation: Validity: single shift (OISD) or 8 hours (IS) [76, 293, 355, 447]. Shift-wise renewal up to maximum 7 days [79, 260, 298, 358, 435, 449]. Shutdown units: max 15 days; Blanket permit: max 30 days [115, 376].
A_permit_types.closure_requirements: Signed by Receiver (housekeeping restored, debris cleared) and Issuer, then submitted to Fire & Safety (F&S) [116, 266, 377, 435].

A_permit_types.purpose_and_criteria: Required for the protection of personnel entering enclosures not designed for continuous occupancy, with restricted means of entry/exit [19, 242, 331, 426].
A_permit_types.type_of_work_examples: Entry/work inside tanks, columns, reactors, oil/water sewer pits, coolers, condensers, sumps, trenches, boiler drums, column skirts, floating roof decks (>3 m down), pipelines, Sumps, pits, tunnels, HVAC ducts [20, 21, 250, 331, 332, 426].
A_permit_types.associated_supporting_permits: Hot Work (outside/inside), Cold Work, Radiography, Excavation, Electrical isolation/Energisation, Working at height [125, 252, 379, 428]
A_permit_types.special_conditions_safety_criteria: Pre-entry checklist is a mandatory prerequisite [132]. Oxygen level >=19.5% (max 23% to prevent enrichment) [56, 114]. Combustible gas <= 5% LEL for entry without mask, up to 20% LEL with air-supplied mask [113, 263]. Only <=24V FLP hand lamps allowed [44, 278]. Minimum 2 trained attendants/standby persons at the manhole [45, 114, 280, 375]. "OK to enter" tag displayed [45].
A_permit_types.approval_requirements: FPS/GSI (Issuer), Receiver/Entry Engineer (Executor), Safety Officer, Plant HOD [111, 134, 187].
A_permit_types.renewal_revalidation: Validity: 8 hours (IS) or single shift (OISD) [76, 293, 355, 447]. Extended up to 7 calendar days with shift-wise joint inspection and gas test re-checks [79, 115, 260, 358, 376, 435].
A_permit_types.closure_requirements: Executor must verify all men and material are removed before boxing up [68, 301, 350]. Signed by Receiver and Issuer [81, 266, 360, 435].
A_permit_types.relevant_section_page: IS 17893 Cl. 3.3, Annex C (Pages 2, 13) [18, 124, 331, 378]; OISD-STD-105 Cl. 4.3, Annexure-II (Pages 2, 12) [250, 293, 426, 447]; ptw aarti Format No. AIL-CS/AMS/MFG/JM/TPL/PMT/03/00 Rev 05 [309, 59].

A_permit_types.purpose_and_criteria: To authorize ground/soil cutting, trenching, or floor breaking while ensuring underground utilities are protected and sides are stable [21, 250, 282, 332].
A_permit_types.type_of_work_examples: Digging/excavation of ground/soil below 30 cm deep (IS 17893) [21, 332] or regardless of depth (OISD) [250, 426]. Dyke cutting, road cutting [155, 282, 391, 440].
A_permit_types.associated_supporting_permits: Excavation Clearance (mandatory prerequisite) [145, 155], Cold Work, Hot Work (for mechanical excavators), Confined Space (if depth >1.2 m), Working at height [146, 384].
A_permit_types.special_conditions_safety_criteria: If depth >1.2 m, must be treated as confined space [160, 395]. Shoring/bracing/sloping side to 45 degrees for depth >=1 m [146, 160]. Ladders every 30.48 m for depth >=1.2 m [161]. Excavated soil placed >=1 m away from edge [147, 163, 385]. Keep 2 m distance for vehicles [164].
A_permit_types.approval_requirements: Issuer, Executor, HOD of issuing department, FSO (Fire Safety Officer) [147, 385].
A_permit_types.renewal_revalidation: Valid normally for 7 days with shift-wise renewal [148, 386]. Shutdown units: max 15 days; Construction: max 30 days [148, 386].
A_permit_types.closure_requirements: Receiver collects all clearance copies, encloses with closed permit, and hands to Issuer [157, 393]. Issuer closes and returns to fire station [157, 393].
A_permit_types.relevant_section_page: IS 17893 Cl. 3.4, Annex D (Pages 2, 15) [21, 143, 332, 381]; OISD-STD-105 Cl. 4.2 & Cl. 6(v) (Pages 2, 7) [250, 282, 426, 440]; ptw aarti Format No. AIL/SFT/F/32 Rev 02 [311, 61].

A_permit_types.purpose_and_criteria: To authorize the positive de-energisation/isolation and subsequent re-energisation of LT/HT power-driven equipment to ensure electrical safety before executing work [22, 165, 253, 333, 397, 429].
A_permit_types.type_of_work_examples: positive isolation of electrical energy source, de-energising MCC/breakers, racking out breakers, pulling fuses, LOTO on local switches, checking insulation resistance, removing temporary safety grounds, racked-in service position re-energising [166, 170, 172, 398, 400].
A_permit_types.associated_supporting_permits: Cold Work, Hot Work, Confined Space Entry, etc. [253, 306, 429, 453]
A_permit_types.special_conditions_safety_criteria: switching off space heater circuit is mandatory along with motor de-energisation unless requested in writing by electrical maintenance [178, 403]. De-energisation and re-energisation clearances must bear the same serial numbers [176].
A_permit_types.approval_requirements: Request filled by Operation-In-Charge of working area (Issuer); Isolation executed and certified by Authorized Person of Electrical Operation [165, 166, 303, 304, 397, 398, 452].
A_permit_types.renewal_revalidation: No separate renewal; permit has Section-A for isolation and Section-B for energisation with same serial number [176, 253, 429].
A_permit_types.closure_requirements: Signed off by electrical operator after performing checks, and original white copy returned to Operation-In-Charge [169, 175, 402].
A_permit_types.relevant_section_page: IS 17893 Cl. 3.5, Annex E (Pages 2, 17) [22, 165, 333, 397]; OISD-STD-105 Cl. 4.4, Annexure-III (Pages 2, 15) [253, 303, 429, 452]; ptw aarti Format No. AIL/SFT/F/29 Rev 02 [313, 63].

A_permit_types.purpose_and_criteria: Required for providing safe access, scaffolding, platforms, and fall protection when working at elevated locations [182, 257, 405, 433].
A_permit_types.type_of_work_examples: Work at or above 1.8 m above ground level where permanent platform and guard railing are not provided [22, 182, 333, 405]. Scaffold erection/dismantling [41].
A_permit_types.associated_supporting_permits: Scaffold pre-erection checklist [193, 201], Scaffold certification, Medical fitness certificate (mandatory for >=2m) [184, 200, 201], Cold Work, Hot Work [195, 413].
A_permit_types.special_conditions_safety_criteria: Full-body double lifeline safety harness with lanyard/energy absorber is mandatory for 2 m and above [50, 197]. Metallic tubular scaffolding only (bamboo prohibited) [41, 191]. Discontinue during rain/high wind [191, 410].
A_permit_types.approval_requirements: GSI/FPS (Issuer), Permittee/Receiver (Executor) [187]. Plant HOD / RSM signature required if needed beyond normal working hours/holidays [188, 407].
A_permit_types.renewal_revalidation: Valid for 8 hours (IS). Renewable on same permit up to maximum 7 calendar days [190, 409].
A_permit_types.closure_requirements: Verified that job is completed, area cleared, and is safe from any hazards. Signed by Issuer and Receiver [188, 407].

A_permit_types.purpose_and_criteria: To authorize radiographic testing using radioactive isotopes or X-ray machines, and manage radiation exposure risks [23, 266, 334, 435].
A_permit_types.type_of_work_examples: Radiography on pipelines/equipment, isolation and restoration of radioactive sources, mobile X-ray/radiography [18, 23, 209].
A_permit_types.associated_supporting_permits: Hot Work (if X-ray machine is used); Cold Work (if isotopes are used) [266, 435].
A_permit_types.special_conditions_safety_criteria: Cordon off area with warning tape and radiation hazard symbol [215]. Distance decided by RSO based on source strength and workload [217]. Use of collimator, radiation survey meter, film badge, concrete wall barrier, pocket dosimeter, alarm/lamp [209, 210]. Radiography supervisor must be available at site [216].
A_permit_types.approval_requirements: supervisory employee under whom contractor works (initiator), GSI/FPS (Issuer), Permittee/Receiver, and HOD/RSO if beyond office hours [62, 208, 212, 347, 414].
A_permit_types.renewal_revalidation: Valid for single use only, duration specified in the permit [76, 355]. Renewed/extended up to 7 calendar days [213, 416].
A_permit_types.closure_requirements: Area cleared and permit returned to issuer [214]. Issuer closes and keeps as record [215].

A_permit_types.purpose_and_criteria: Combines checklists and controls for multiple related tasks inside/outside a confined space under a single permit to streamline work authorization [252, 428].
A_permit_types.type_of_work_examples: Hot work outside the confined space, entry, and cold/hot work inside the confined space [252, 428].
A_permit_types.associated_supporting_permits: Supplements / incorporates Hot Work and Confined Space Entry [252, 428].
A_permit_types.special_conditions_safety_criteria: Must address all applicable checklist aspects of both hot work and confined space entry [252, 428].
A_permit_types.approval_requirements: Issuer (Shift In-Charge) and Receiver (Executor) [252, 298, 428].
A_permit_types.renewal_revalidation: Renewed/extended shift-wise up to maximum 7 calendar days [260, 298].
A_permit_types.closure_requirements: Both Receiver and Issuer must sign to confirm job completion and housekeeping [266, 299].

A_permit_types.purpose_and_criteria: Optional streamlined permit integrating cold/hot/entry/electrical isolation work while complying with all requirements of individual permits [247, 423].
A_permit_types.type_of_work_examples: Cold/hot/confined space entry/electrical isolation works [247, 423].
A_permit_types.associated_supporting_permits: Integrates individual permits [247, 423].
A_permit_types.special_conditions_safety_criteria: Must satisfy all the checklists, monitoring parameters, and safeguards of individual permits [247, 423].
A_permit_types.approval_requirements: Same as individual permits [247, 423].
A_permit_types.renewal_revalidation: Same as individual permits [247, 423].
A_permit_types.closure_requirements: Same as individual permits [247, 423].

A_permit_types.purpose_and_criteria: Required for authorizing work on fragile roofs, focusing on fall protection, secure access, and area safety below [65].
A_permit_types.type_of_work_examples: Chipping, repairs, cleaning, or maintenance work on fragile roofs [65].
A_permit_types.associated_supporting_permits: Working at Height, Cold Work, Hot Work [65].
A_permit_types.special_conditions_safety_criteria: Safe access/suitable ladder. Area below cordoned off. Crawling boards/duck ladder/roof ladder. Full body harness with double cross rope. Safety net fixed below. PPE checked [65].
A_permit_types.approval_requirements: Civil In-charge, Initiator, Permittee, Safety Dept. Remarks, and HOD Name & Signature [65].
A_permit_types.renewal_revalidation: Validity: renewed with dates, times, and signatures of Permittee, Initiator, and HOD [65].
A_permit_types.closure_requirements: Closed with date & time, signed by Production Dept and Mech/Elect/Civil/Inst Dept [65].
A_permit_types.relevant_section_page: ptw aarti template, Format No. AIL/SFT/F/31 Rev 02 (Page 1) [315, 65].

B_common_permit_fields.specimen_context_remarks: Recorded as "Sl.No." or "Sr. No. G" [63, 65, 88, 284]. For electrical, follows "XXX/ZZZZ/YY" book nomenclature [181, 404].
Format: "From: ____ hrs of date ____" [89, 284].
Format: "To: ____ hrs of date ____" [89, 284].
Identifies the executing agency [89, 284].
Identifies Area/Unit/Equipment No. etc. [89, 285].
Unique safety reference in IS formats [89, 104].
Precise description of work. Must have at least two lines in printed forms [257, 285].
The person executing/responsible for the job [90, 258].
Selection of Normal, Shutdown, Construction, or Blanket [105, 144].
Reference to SAP PM / maintenance system notification [63, 65].
Used to cross-reference hot/cold/height/isolation permits [63, 65].
Identifies unique master list tag number [25, 269].
Field to specify the count of crew members [63, 65].
Aarti template field for the contractor supervisor [63, 65].
Specific physical spot context [61, 91].
Cross-reference to the Job Safety Analysis sheet [63, 65].
"In case of emergency:" blank section on form [63, 65].

number_of_copies.OISD_STD_105: Cold Work: Min 2 copies [248]. Hot Work: Min 3 copies (4 if Fire and Safety sections are separate) [249]. Confined Space: Min 3 copies [251]. Electrical: Triplicate (printed in 2 sections with tear-off facility) [253].
number_of_copies.IS_17893_2023: General PTW: Triplicate [9, 322]. Cold Work (Annex A): Duplicate [369]. Excavation (Annex D): Triplicate [148, 386]. Work at Height (Annex F): Triplicate [190, 409]. Radiation (Annex G): Duplicate [214, 416]. Electrical (Annex E): Triplicate (one page with 2 vertical perforations), and issued in duplicate (white and pink copies) to electrical section [173, 174, 175, 402].
number_of_copies.Aarti_Industries: Multi-part forms with clear block fields (PART-I for inspections, PART-II for signatures/permits, PART-III for approvals/Safety remarks) on a single physical sheet [63, 65].

permit_colour_coding.OISD_STD_105: Cold Work: Original in Yellow, duplicate has "COPY" printed in large yellow letters [248]. Hot Work: Original in Pink, duplicate/triplicate has "COPY" printed in large pink letters [249]. Confined Space: Original color different than cold/hot (with "COPY" in large letters) [251]. Electrical: Original in color different from others (with "COPY" in large letters) [253].
permit_colour_coding.IS_17893_2023: Cold Work (Annex A): Original in Yellow (for receiver), duplicate in White (for issuer) [369]. Work at Height (Annex F): Original Green, duplicate White (for issuer), triplicate White (for permittee) [190, 409]. Radiation (Annex G): Original Blue (issued to permittee), duplicate White (retained by issuer) [214, 416]. Electrical (Annex E): Issued as White and Pink copies [175].
permit_colour_coding.Aarti_Industries: Custom physical paper sets corresponding to Aarti's internal safety standards (Format No. printed on form) [63, 65].

permit_numbering.OISD_STD_105: All permits must be serially numbered [255].
permit_numbering.IS_17893_2023: Electrical isolation serial numbers follow: "XXX/ZZZZ/YY" (where XXX is the 3-digit book number, ZZZZ is the 4-digit clearance number, and YY is the last 2 digits of current year) [181, 404]. De-energising and re-energising clearances must bear the same serial number [176].
permit_numbering.Aarti_Industries: Pre-printed "Sr. No G" serial numbering blocks on headers [63, 65].

worksite_availability_display.OISD_STD_105: Original copy issued to the receiver [248]. Permit must be available at the work site at all times [292, 302, 446, 451].
worksite_availability_display.IS_17893_2023: Acceptor must display his copy (first copy) at the job location to make area personnel aware and readily available for audit [9, 65, 323, 349]. Original permit must be available at work site at all times [97, 116, 148, 192, 214, 368, 377, 386, 411, 416].
worksite_availability_display.Aarti_Industries: Displayed at work site. Includes "Workmen Deployed" list on the permit itself for auditing crew members [63, 65].

record_keeping_retention.OISD_STD_105: Completed/used permits must be properly filed and kept as records for at least Three months from completion of work or successful commissioning of the facility, whichever is later [267, 436].
record_keeping_retention.IS_17893_2023: Original/acceptor copy of all closed permits kept by issuer for at least 30 days from closure [88, 363].
record_keeping_retention.Aarti_Industries: Enclose closed underground clearance copies with closed excavation permit, and returned to fire station as a permanent safety record [157, 393].

corrections_alterations.OISD_STD_105: Additions and alterations on the original shall also be endorsed on all the copies [256, 432].
corrections_alterations.IS_17893_2023: Must be filled up carefully and accurately in clear handwriting; no columns left blank [95, 112, 214, 367, 375, 416].
corrections_alterations.Aarti_Industries: Hand-written corrections must be signed off or initialed (noted in blank spaces) [63, 65].

sketches_drawings_attachments.OISD_STD_105: Sketches should be attached wherever possible to avoid miscommunication [256, 269, 290, 300, 432]. Attachments: excavation permission, working at height supplementary checklist (OISD-STD-192), dyke/road cutting clearance [250, 257, 282, 426, 433, 440].
sketches_drawings_attachments.IS_17893_2023: Sketches should be provided wherever possible [95, 112, 193, 367, 375, 411]. Attachments: marked-up drawings of excavation area [144, 382]; excavation clearance [145, 148, 155, 383, 386, 391]; Do's and Don'ts sheets [98, 116, 158, 369, 377, 394]; Confined space entrant attendance sheet [141-142].
sketches_drawings_attachments.Aarti_Industries: Mandatory sketch of excavation area to be enclosed [61, 91]. JSA sheet referenced and attached [63, 65].

document_control.OISD_STD_105: Approved by the owner and adopted site-specifically under the work permit system [268, 437].
document_control.IS_17893_2023: Refineries use custom format code: replace two stars (**) in format no. with refinery initials (e.g. HR, MR, BR, GR, DR etc.) [181, 404].
document_control.Aarti_Industries: Controlled Formats: Format No. AIL/SFT/F/31 Rev 02 (Fragile), AIL/SFT/F/32 Rev 02 (Excavation), AIL/SFT/F/29 Rev 02 (Electrical), AIL-CS/AMS/MFG/JM/TPL/PMT/03/00 Rev 05 (Confined Space) [63, 65, 91, 93].

D_basic_ptw_workflow.name: Request / Initiation
D_basic_ptw_workflow.action: A written request is initiated when maintenance, repair, or inspection work is planned [3, 255].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.responsible_role: Initiated by either the Issuer (shift in-charge) or the Acceptor/Executor (who carries out the work) [10, 25, 323].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.details: Description of the job, equipment master tag numbers, and contractors involved are filled in the permit's "Job Particulars" header [24, 25, 26, 335, 336].

D_basic_ptw_workflow.name: Joint Site Inspection & Risk Assessment
D_basic_ptw_workflow.action: Issuer and Executor jointly visit the physical job location before filling other details [11, 63, 64, 324, 348].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.responsible_role: Issuer (Shift In-Charge) and Executor (Maintenance/Construction Supervisor) [11, 63, 64, 324, 348].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.details: They conduct a joint risk assessment to agree on the safe execution procedures, required equipment preparation, and additional PPE required for the work [11, 63, 64, 324, 348].

D_basic_ptw_workflow.name: Equipment Preparation & Process Isolation
D_basic_ptw_workflow.action: Operating department prepares the equipment to make it safe [33, 274, 275].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.responsible_role: Operating department, Area Operator, and Issuer [33, 274, 275].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.details: Includes depressurizing, draining, washing, steaming, or inert-gas purging [33, 34, 274, 275]. Positive isolation is achieved by slip blinding or physical line disconnection [30, 31, 32, 274]. Closing isolation valves alone is not reliable for hot work/confined entry [30, 31]. Area Operator attaches "DO NOT OPERATE" isolation tags to valves/breakers and logs LOTO [32, 33].

D_basic_ptw_workflow.name: Gas Testing
D_basic_ptw_workflow.action: Mandatory atmospheric gas tests are performed [55, 262, 341].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.responsible_role: Permit Issuer or authorized Gas Tester / GSI (Gas Safety Inspector) [55, 262, 341].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.details: Tests for oxygen content (min 19.5%), hydrocarbon content (% LEL must be zero), and toxic contents (below TLV) [56, 57, 263, 342, 434]. Must be completed prior to permit issue and repeated just prior to starting hot work or entry [57, 341]. Tested within a 5-meter radius of hot work [55, 341].

D_basic_ptw_workflow.name: Permit Authorization / Approval
D_basic_ptw_workflow.action: The permit is authorized and signed [58, 254].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.responsible_role: Issuer (Shift In-Charge) and Plant/Area In-Charge or Plant HOD [10, 58, 59, 62, 69, 254, 258, 323, 343, 346, 351, 430].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.details: The Shift In-Charge issues the permit for his jurisdiction [59, 254, 343]. For critical permits (Hot Work, Confined Space Entry, Excavation), authorization must be elevated to the Plant/Area In-Charge or HOD [59, 69, 258, 343, 351, 433]. Certain permits (Excavation, Radiation) must be registered at the Fire Station [148, 208, 386, 414].

D_basic_ptw_workflow.name: Acceptance & Toolbox Talk
D_basic_ptw_workflow.action: Permit acceptance and safety briefing of workers [64, 66, 348, 349].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.responsible_role: Executor / Receiver / Permittee [64, 66, 348, 349].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.details: The Executor signs the permit to accept responsibility for safe work execution and compliance with precautions [64, 348]. He must conduct a mandatory safety toolbox talk to all contract/departmental workers emphasizing the procedures, hazards, and precautions before starting work [66, 98, 117, 149, 193, 349, 369, 377, 387, 412].

D_basic_ptw_workflow.name: Area Operator Endorsement & Work Start
D_basic_ptw_workflow.action: Final worksite check and sign-off [65, 70, 349, 352].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.responsible_role: Maintenance Technician / Contractor Supervisor and Area Operator [65, 70, 349, 352].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.details: The supervisor presents the signed permit to the Area Operator at the worksite [70, 352]. The Area Operator satisfies himself that worksite conditions comply with permit precautions, signs the permit, and returns it to allow work to start [65, 70, 349, 352].

D_basic_ptw_workflow.name: Work Monitoring & Shift Handovers
D_basic_ptw_workflow.action: Continuous safety watch and shift change reviews [62, 71, 72, 85, 259, 260, 346, 352, 362].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.responsible_role: Area Operator, Safety Officer, and incoming Shift In-Charges [62, 71, 72, 85, 259, 260, 346, 352, 362, 435].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.details: Area Operator keeps watch and suspends the job if hazardous conditions develop [71, 72, 352]. Safety Officer makes periodic checks and can suspend work if unsafe [259, 435]. Incoming shift operators and Shift In-Charges must review all ongoing permits and put their signatures/endorsements on the permit to allow continuation [62, 71, 72, 346, 352].

D_basic_ptw_workflow.name: Suspension & Cancellation
D_basic_ptw_workflow.action: Stopping work due to unsafe deviations, accidents, or emergencies [11, 72, 81, 82, 259, 352, 361, 435].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.responsible_role: Issuer, Executor, Area Operator, Safety Officer, or Auditor [11, 72, 81, 82, 259, 352, 361, 435].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.details: Permit is automatically suspended/cancelled on: (a) site emergency declaration, (b) any accident in the area, or (c) violation of permit conditions [81, 82, 361]. Temporary suspensions are allowed until conditions are rectified [82, 361].

D_basic_ptw_workflow.name: Revalidation & Renewals (Validity Extension)
D_basic_ptw_workflow.action: Extending validity for continuing work [76, 77, 260, 355, 356, 435].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.responsible_role: Acceptor (requests) and Issuer (revalidates) [77, 78, 357].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.details: OISD permits are valid for a single shift; IS permits are valid for 8 hours [76, 260, 284, 293, 355]. To extend, the Acceptor fills the backside revalidation block [77, 357]. Issuer conducts a joint site inspection, repeats gas tests, and gets endorsements from the Area Operator and other signatories [78, 79, 357, 358]. Cold, hot, entry, and excavation permits can be extended up to a maximum of 7 calendar days, after which a new permit must be issued [79, 80, 260, 358, 359, 435]. If there is a break of >1 calendar day, a new permit is required [80, 359].

D_basic_ptw_workflow.name: Completion, Housekeeping & Restoration
D_basic_ptw_workflow.action: Restoring the area and boxing up equipment [67, 68, 80, 81, 266, 350, 359, 435].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.responsible_role: Receiver / Executor and Contractor Supervisor [67, 68, 80, 81, 266, 350, 359, 435].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.details: On job completion, the executing agency removes all tools, tackles, scaffolding, and surplus materials, cleans the area, and reinstalls any removed guards/gratings [80, 81, 359, 360]. For confined spaces, the Executor must ensure that all men and material are counted and removed from the space before boxing up manholes [68, 301, 350, 451].

D_basic_ptw_workflow.name: Closure
D_basic_ptw_workflow.action: Official closure of the permit [81, 266, 360, 435].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.responsible_role: Receiver, Area Operator, and Issuer [71, 81, 266, 360, 435].
D_basic_ptw_workflow.details: Area Operator inspects the worksite for housekeeping, signs the completion section, and hands it to the Receiver [71]. Receiver certifies completion/stoppage [94, 289, 366, 444]. Issuer verifies the area is safe and signs the permit [94, 289, 366, 444]. The permit is only treated as officially "Closed" once both Issuer and Receiver sign [266, 435]. Completed permits are filed [267, 363, 436].

E_roles_and_responsibilities.key_responsibilities: Controls the entire work permit process [9, 23, 60, 322, 344, 345]. Verifies equipment preparation and safety checks [61, 345]. Performs independent risk assessments for difficult/unfrequent jobs [61, 345]. Issues separate permits for preparatory jobs (scaffolding, blinding) [61, 345].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.scope_of_authority: Controls operations area. Typically the shift in-charge of operations (Shift Engineer, Depot In-charge, Installation Manager) [10, 25, 254, 323, 430].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.signature_responsibility: Signs for permit issuance, revalidations, renewals, and official closure [62, 78, 81, 94, 288, 346, 357, 360, 366].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.restrictions_special_scope: Restriction: No person is allowed to issue a work permit to himself [60, 344].

E_roles_and_responsibilities.key_responsibilities: Jointly inspects job location with Issuer to plan preparations/PPE [63, 64, 348]. Responsible for safe work execution and compliance with precautions [64, 348]. Conducts daily safety toolbox talks and ensures worker awareness [66, 349]. Ensures contractor supervisor provides correct PPE [67, 349]. Restores housekeeping to normal [67, 350].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.scope_of_authority: Controls the execution of maintenance, construction, or inspection work. Authorized by engineering HOD [63, 347].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.signature_responsibility: Signs the permit acceptance block, request for revalidation/renewal (backside), and completion certificate [64, 77, 81, 94, 288, 348, 357, 360, 366].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.restrictions_special_scope: Restriction: Must be a company employee [63, 347]. direct contractor supervisor sign-off only allowed in small installations with no company supervisor [258, 433].

E_roles_and_responsibilities.key_responsibilities: Attaches "DO NOT OPERATE" isolation tags [33]. Verifies worksite compliance and signs permit [65, 70, 349, 352]. Inspects housekeeping before closure [71]. Keeps continuous watch on jobs in progress [71, 352].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.scope_of_authority: Can suspend work immediately if hazardous conditions develop, informing the Shift In-Charge [72, 352].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.signature_responsibility: Signs the permit to authorize work start, incoming shift endorsements, and completion inspection [65, 71, 72, 79, 349, 352, 358].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.restrictions_special_scope: Operating operator under operations shift supervisor.

E_roles_and_responsibilities.key_responsibilities: Identifies, trains, and validates PTW personnel [87, 88, 363]. Publishes lists of validated authorized signatories [88, 363]. Evaluates and elevates permit authorizations for critical jobs [258, 433].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.scope_of_authority: Holds final local authority. Signs above Shift In-Charge level [69, 351].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.signature_responsibility: Signs final authorization for hot work, confined entry, excavation, and road/dyke cutting [59, 69, 258, 343, 351, 433].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.restrictions_special_scope: HOD himself can sign as Plant/Area In-Charge to authorize permits [70, 351].

E_roles_and_responsibilities.key_responsibilities: Performs mandatory atmospheric gas tests (oxygen, hydrocarbons, toxics) [55, 262, 341]. Decides testing frequency and intervals [58, 341]. Calibrates/checks operability of portable testers [117, 377].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.scope_of_authority: Independent check authority for atmospheric hazards.
E_roles_and_responsibilities.signature_responsibility: Logs gas values and signs gas test columns on permit [55, 80, 111, 134, 341, 358, 380].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.restrictions_special_scope: Authorized by plant HOD / area in-charge [58, 341].

E_roles_and_responsibilities.key_responsibilities: Arranges training and validation of all signatories and auditors [86, 87, 362]. Develops validation and training materials [87, 362]. Resolves differences in PTW interpretation [87, 362]. Conducts periodic/random site audits [84, 85, 259, 362, 435].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.scope_of_authority: Can suspend work immediately and cancel permits if conditions are unsafe [85, 259, 362, 435].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.signature_responsibility: Signs permit audit sheets and Safety Department remarks on custom forms [65, 83].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.restrictions_special_scope: Safety department personnel. Audit frequency must be at least once a week [85, 362].

E_roles_and_responsibilities.key_responsibilities: Always available at confined space manhole/entry [45, 114, 280, 375]. Keeps constant touch with entrants and logs entry/exit [138, 142]. Arranges rescue and raises alarm in distress [45, 138, 142].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.scope_of_authority: Stationed outside. Never enters the space unless relieved.
E_roles_and_responsibilities.signature_responsibility: Signs the confined space entrant attendance sheet (Table 13) [141-142].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.restrictions_special_scope: Restriction: Must not be given any other duty which causes his absence from the manhole [140-141].

E_roles_and_responsibilities.key_responsibilities: Establishes safe boundaries and cordon-off distances [217]. Issues guidelines for radiation source movement [216]. Establishes barricading and warning tape layout [215].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.scope_of_authority: Radiation protection advisor.
E_roles_and_responsibilities.signature_responsibility: Signs radiation permit approvals, particularly for work beyond office hours [212].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.restrictions_special_scope: Must be designated by the employer and qualified under Rule 22 of Atomic Energy (Radiation Protection) Rules, 2004 [216].

E_roles_and_responsibilities.key_responsibilities: De-energizes MCCs/breakers, conducts LOTO, and safety locks [166, 170]. Verifies earthing, control fuse, and space heaters [170]. Re-energizes and removes danger tags [167, 170].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.scope_of_authority: Authorized electrical specialist.
E_roles_and_responsibilities.signature_responsibility: Signs Section-A (de-energisation), Section-B (re-energisation), and Job Completion Certificate [165, 169, 305, 307, 397].
E_roles_and_responsibilities.restrictions_special_scope: Electrical operations specialist.
